name: Camping zur Mühle
beschreibung: The Campingplatz zur Mühle is located in a rural setting in Tirol, named after a historic mill on the grounds. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and tents in a close-to-nature atmosphere. The facilities include sanitary amenities and a supply and disposal station. From here, guests can go hiking in the surrounding mountains. The site is suitable for nature lovers and those seeking relaxation. A small playground is available for families.
